name: Aviation Weather (METAR/TAF)
author: e2jk
description: Aviation flight-category indicator (VFR/MVFR/IFR/LIFR) for your favorite airports, with a METAR/TAF detail popup

barWidget.description: Aviation flight-category letters for configured airports; click for full METAR/TAF detail

schema.label: Airports (ICAO)
schema.description: Comma-separated ICAO station identifiers (exactly 4 characters each), e.g. EBAW,EBBR,EBCI

schema.label: Units
schema.description: Metric: °C, km, hPa. Imperial: °F, mi, inHg. Wind speed always stays in knots, the aviation standard everywhere.

schema.label: Show TAF
schema.description: Include the Terminal Aerodrome Forecast under each station's METAR.

schema.label: Show station name in tooltip
schema.description: Include the full airport name in the hover tooltip, not just the ICAO code and category.

schema.label: METAR/TAF report style
schema.description: Decoded: plain-English report, hover to see the raw coded text. Coded: raw METAR/TAF text, hover to see it decoded.

schema.label: Max data age (minutes)
schema.description: Aviation weather is hyper-local and changes fast. A station's last report older than this is treated as no data rather than shown as current.

schema.label: Hover refresh threshold (minutes)
schema.description: Hovering the bar refreshes in the background if the data is older than this. Silent unless something actually changed.
